labels.POSTERIOR_TORSO_VISIBLE: A contiguous visible outer-surface region on the back/posterior torso is supported by the RGB silhouette and local appearance; clothing is allowed and must be marked.
labels.NON_POSTERIOR_BODY: Visible person pixels are present but the region is anterior, lateral-only, limb, head, or otherwise not posterior torso.
labels.OCCLUDED: Posterior torso is expected from context but the relevant surface is blocked by limb, object, crop, or invalid depth.
labels.UNCERTAIN: The view/appearance does not support a reliable posterior-vs-non-posterior decision. Do not force a polygon.

surface_semantics: If clothing covers the body, the annotated surface is POSTERIOR_CLOTHED_TORSO outer surface, never bare-back skin or medical ground truth.
qa_gate: At least one second independent review on a subset; disagreement becomes UNCERTAIN until resolved from pixels.
current_blocker: The repository handoff contains sealed geometry caches and contact sheets, but no verified independent Camera-B posterior masks/regions. Running O/A/C/G scoring now would risk model self-evaluation.
